verses.en: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
verses.pt: Disto também o meu coração treme, e salta de seu lugar.
verses.en_web: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.
verses.en_bbe: At this my heart is shaking; it is moved out of its place.

verses.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
verses.pt: Ouvi atentamente o estrondo de sua voz, e o som que sai de sua boca,
verses.en_web: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the rolling noise of his voice; to the hollow sound which goes out of his mouth.

verses.en: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.pt: Ao qual envia por debaixo de todos os céus; e sua luz até os confins da terra.
verses.en_web: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: He sends it out through all the heaven, and his thunder-flame to the ends of the earth.

verses.en: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.pt: Depois disso brama com estrondo; troveja com sua majestosa voz; e ele não retém seus relâmpagos quando sua voz é ouvida.
verses.en_web: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.
verses.en_bbe: After it a voice is sounding, thundering out the word of his power; he does not keep back his thunder-flames; from his mouth his voice is sounding.

verses.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.pt: Deus troveja maravilhosamente com sua voz; ele faz coisas tão grandes que nós não compreendemos.
verses.en_web: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
verses.en_bbe: He does wonders, more than may be searched out; great things of which we have no knowledge;

verses.en: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.pt: Pois ele diz à neve: Cai sobre à terra; Como também à chuva: Sê chuva forte.
verses.en_web: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth;’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.
verses.en_bbe: For he says to the snow, Make the earth wet; and to the rain-storm, Come down.

verses.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
verses.pt: Ele sela as mãos de todo ser humano, para que todas as pessoas conheçam sua obra.
verses.en_web: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
verses.en_bbe: He puts an end to the work of every man, so that all may see his work.

verses.en: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.pt: E os animais selvagens entram nos esconderijos, e ficam em suas tocas.
verses.en_web: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.
verses.en_bbe: Then the beasts go into their holes, and take their rest.

verses.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
verses.pt: Da recâmara vem o redemoinho, e dos ventos que espalham vem o frio.
verses.en_web: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.
verses.en_bbe: Out of its place comes the storm-wind, and the cold out of its store-houses.

verses.en: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.pt: Pelo sopro de Deus se dá o gelo, e as largas águas se congelam.
verses.en_web: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.
verses.en_bbe: By the breath of God ice is made, and the wide waters are shut in.

verses.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
verses.pt: Ele também carrega de umidade as espessas nuvens, e por entre as nuvens ele espalha seu relâmpago.
verses.en_web: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.
verses.en_bbe: The thick cloud is weighted with thunder-flame, and the cloud sends out its light;

verses.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
verses.pt: Então elas se movem ao redor segundo sua condução, para que façam quanto ele lhes manda sobre a superfície do mundo, na terra;
verses.en_web: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,
verses.en_bbe: And it goes this way and that, round about, turning itself by his guiding, to do whatever he gives orders to be done, on the face of his world of men,

verses.en: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
verses.pt: Seja que ou por vara de castigo, ou para sua terra, ou por bondade as faça vir.
verses.en_web: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.
verses.en_bbe: For a rod, or for a curse, or for mercy, causing it to come on the mark.

verses.en: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.pt: Escuta isto, Jó; fica parado, e considera as maravilhas de Deus.
verses.en_web: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to this, O Job, and keep quiet in your place; and take note of the wonders worked by God.

verses.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
verses.pt: Por acaso sabes tu quando Deus dá ordem a elas, e faz brilhar o relâmpago de sua nuvem?
verses.en_web: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?
verses.en_bbe: Have you knowledge of God's ordering of his works, how he makes the light of his cloud to be seen?

verses.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
verses.pt: Conheces tu os equilíbrios das nuvens, as maravilhas daquele que é perfeito no conhecimento?
verses.en_web: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
verses.en_bbe: Have you knowledge of the balancings of the clouds, the wonders of him who has all wisdom?

verses.en: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?
verses.pt: Tu, cujas vestes se aquecem quando a terra se aquieta por causa do vento sul,
verses.en_web: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?
verses.en_bbe: You, whose clothing is warm, when the earth is quiet because of the south wind,

verses.en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
verses.pt: acaso podes estender com ele os céus, que estão firmes como um espelho fundido?
verses.en_web: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
verses.en_bbe: Will you, with him, make the skies smooth, and strong as a polished looking-glass?

verses.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
verses.pt: Ensina-nos o que devemos dizer a ele; pois discurso nenhum podemos propor, por causa das nossas trevas.
verses.en_web: Teach us what we shall tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.
verses.en_bbe: Make clear to me what we are to say to him; we are unable to put our cause before him, because of the dark.

verses.en: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.pt: Seria contado a ele o que eu haveria de falar? Por acaso alguém falaria para ser devorado?
verses.en_web: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?
verses.en_bbe: How may he have knowledge of my desire for talk with him? or did any man ever say, May destruction come on me?

verses.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.pt: E agora não se pode olhar para o sol, quando brilha nos céus, quando o vento passa e os limpa.
verses.en_web: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
verses.en_bbe: And now the light is not seen, for it is dark because of the clouds; but a wind comes, clearing them away.

verses.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
verses.pt: Do norte vem o esplendor dourado; em Deus há majestade temível.
verses.en_web: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
verses.en_bbe: A bright light comes out of the north; God's glory is greatly to be feared.

verses.en: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.pt: Não podemos alcançar ao Todo-Poderoso; ele é grande em poder; porém ele a ninguém oprime em juízo e grandeza de justiça.
verses.en_web: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
verses.en_bbe: There is no searching out of the Ruler of all: his strength and his judging are great; he is full of righteousness, doing no wrong.

verses.en: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.pt: Por isso as pessoas o temem; ele não dá atenção aos que se acham sábios de coração.
verses.en_web: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”
verses.en_bbe: For this cause men go in fear of him; he has no respect for any who are wise in heart.
